ERR-004 • The Aethelgard Archives / Blacksburg Studio Collective • 2017–Present

Mana Canvas

Symphonic Fantasy Rock, 16-Bit SNES Chiptune & Acoustic RPG Alchemy

The official musical voice of the Aethel Saga and Runebreaker universes. Mana Canvas fuses authentic 16-bit Super Famicom / SNES SPC700 synth nostalgia with roaring progressive rock guitars, orchestral strings, and tavern acoustic storytelling.

What Kind of Music Is Mana Canvas? 16-bit SNES RPG chiptune leads fused with symphonic progressive metal, Celtic/fantasy acoustic ballads, and boss-battle rock operas.

Canonical In-Universe History

1. Canonical Band Lore & Sanctuary History

Scoring the Aethel Saga & Runebreaker

Mana Canvas bridges RaggieSoft's literary fantasy universes (The Aethel Saga and Runebreaker on books.raggiesoft.com) with Engine Room Records' audio engineering. Every release is structured like a golden-era 1990s 16-bit RPG soundtrack brought to life with a full rock orchestra.

Songs of the Untethered & The Silver Gauntlet of Aethel

Across releases like Songs of the Untethered and The Silver Gauntlet of Aethel, Mana Canvas pairs nostalgic pixel-era melodies with full-bandwidth progressive rock instrumentation—celebrating characters who break free from predetermined system rules.

Runebreaker Live
